verdict.rationale: Capacities' own docs describe a built-in AI assistant. It offers AI Chats with notes as context and a selection-based AI panel for translation, rewriting and summarization. The AI can also plan multi-step work and propose creates and updates for the user to approve, alongside auto-fill of properties and auto-tagging. The pricing page lists the AI assistant as a feature. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of delegation quality, and deeper documentation of the multi-step planning and approval workflow, which gets only a single sentence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: The AI answers based on your notes, can plan multi-step work, and can propose creates and updates for you to approve.
After selecting blocks in your content, you can quickly launch the AI panel to perform tasks such as translation, rewriting, or summarization.
Start a chat with AI from Explore, or with a keyboard shortcut. You can pass blocks or notes as context.
you can rely on the AI model's knowledge to auto-fill them for you.
